move.subject: RFQ pump shaft HX (part:320070)
move.body:
Dear Ms Fuchsreiter,

thank you for your offer. We are awarding the HX pump shaft (part:320070) for the series start in March 2027: 4,200 pieces a year, binding for 24 months.

Straight talk on payment: over the last 12 months we paid 93% of your invoices late, on average 11.5 days after the due date - your letter of 18 August was right. That ends with this contract: 14 days net, every invoice paid on the due date.

It is steady work for the second shift you told us has been on hold since spring.

We have an offer at EUR 31.50 per piece (offer:70240-0).

We propose EUR 24.50 per piece, 14 days net, 28 days lead time (term sheet attached).

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke
